cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for dinner with me. I've learned your mother's dumplings, and they're ready to steam. We serve them now, not between other appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's at the networking dinner. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I need you to choose our dinner. Two places, food prepared, you actually sitting at one of them. That's the arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We froze our anniversary dinner on that promise. Turn the steamer on, please, and tell the director you're already having dinner with me.
